text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The challenge of Japanese Umamusume taking 
on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe began 
with Speed Symboli. The future entrusted 
to them connects straight to the present 
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Representative Exchange Race 
concludes, and the Umamusume who will 
represent Japan are decided. <chrname> is chosen as 
one of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The modern Japanese Umamusume who carry on 
history— Their running, so full of hope, 
makes even the pioneer Speed Symboli feel 
a pang of envy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The romance of reaching the world's 
summit. The burning passion and 
accumulated feelings of countless 
Umamusume push <chrname> and the others forward...!
